clips.title: The story
paras: Brine sends the Empty Blue Waterskin north from the Barrens to gather sacred water. The liquid will help her prepare the draught needed to summon and appease the water spirit.

Brine gives the Empty Blue Waterskin to a shaman initiate at her hilltop hut in the southern Barrens. The vessel marks the final and most perilous gathering task of early training. To commune with the spirit of water, the initiate must seek pure, undisturbed sources across Kalimdor. The waterskin is meant for a secluded fountain deep within the Ruins of Stardust, along Ashenvale's contested borderlands.

The initiate must leave the safety of Horde territory and travel into ancient groves guarded by nature beasts and night elves. At a fountain in the ruined sanctuary deep within the Ruins of Stardust, the waterskin is filled and becomes a Filled Blue Waterskin. With water samples from the Barrens and Tarren Mill, its contents let Brine brew the draught needed to summon and appease the elemental spirit of water.
